items.headline: Latest updates on how the FAA ground stop will affect college football
items.description: The SEC Now crew provides updates on how games are being affected by transportation issues as Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson analyze the impact on players.

items.headline: Chris Doering dissects key storylines in three Week 11 matchups

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for multiple sports have been disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.headline: Kamario Taylor: Easy call to return to Mississippi St., unfinished business left
items.description: Kamario Taylor said Thursday that his decision to return to Mississippi State next season was an easy call.

items.headline: 2027 NFL draft Big Board rankings: Mel Kiper's top 25 prospects, best by position
items.description: Seven quarterbacks ranked in the top 25? This NFL draft class could be fun. Mel Kiper Jr. stacks the best players on the board as of mid-November.

items.headline: Sources: Kamario Taylor finalizing deal to return to Mississippi State in '27
items.description: Mississippi State star quarterback Kamario Taylor is finalizing a deal Wednesday to return to the Bulldogs in 2027, sources told ESPN.
